name: image-to-web
task: Inspect assets/moonroot-campaign.png with view_image, then build an accessible responsive one-page campaign in index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use the supplied image as the hero artwork and preserve its center-right copy-safe region by placing hero copy there without obscuring the moon or birds. Required exact interface copy: headline "A Rooftop After Dark", CTA "Reserve a Moonbed", and toggle labels "Night" and "Dawn". The toggle must switch a data-theme value between night and dawn, update aria-pressed, and work by click plus the N and D keys. Include reduced-motion CSS and a concise image alt description grounded in visible facts. The page must be self-contained and usable offline: do not load fonts, scripts, styles, or other resources from external URLs or CDNs. Run BANTAM preview after implementation. Do not modify the image, tests, or package configuration.
